heading: The second Fiume household: Joannes Baptista and Magdalena
lead: For twenty years this archive read Fiume as **one** Defranceschi house — Valentino the Carnian's. On 20 September 2026 a frame-by-frame sweep of the baptism film turned up **another**, baptising in the same church in the same decade: **D.nus Joannes Baptista de Franceschi and D.na Magdalena**. They matter more than a second household usually would, because **their son is almost certainly the Giuseppe who heads the Rijeka chain** — the line that runs on through a Valentino born 1772, twenty-one children on Ursula between 1794 and 1805, and a Franciscus fathering four more to 1836. **Everything downstream of Giuseppe has been hanging off nothing.** This is what it hangs off.

rows.lab: Fiume, 29 May 1748 — the household's own child, and in no index anywhere
rows.q: Die 29 May 1748. **Josephum Aloysium** filium legitimum D.ni **Joannis Baptæ** et D.næ **Magdalenæ** jugalium **de Franceschi**, natum 24 hujus, baptizavit D.nus Canonicus Eustachius Sauf. Patrini fuere D.nus Josephus Voxila et D.na Eleonora Moroldi.
rows.en: On 29 May 1748. Josephus Aloysius, lawful son of D.nus Joannes Baptista and D.na Magdalena, husband and wife, de Franceschi, born on the 24th of this month, was baptised by D.nus Canon Eustachius Sauf. The godparents were D.nus Josephus Voxila and D.na Eleonora Moroldi.
rows.why:
**Film 005497925, image 150** (`3:1:3QS7-L99F-W4CK`). The sweep was hunting a son of *Valentino* in the 1746–1750 gap and found a different family's son instead.

**Why this is Giuseppe.** **Giuseppe × Francesca** baptised four children at Fiume — 1772, 1774, 1776, 1778 — and their eldest is christened *Valentinus*. A man born **24 May 1748** is **twenty-four** at that first baptism, which is exactly right. The MyHeritage tree already carried **Giuseppe Defranceschi b. 1748, d. 1778** at Rijeka with **no source at all**; the register now supplies one, and **1748 was right**. His last child is baptised 8 February 1778, and the tree's death year is 1778.

*Still `inf`. No entry anywhere says «Josephus filius Joannis Baptistæ».*

rows.lab: Fiume, 9 December 1771 — a widower remarries, and the first wife is gone
rows.q: **Joannes Baptista Defranceschi**, widower, and **Catharina de Benzoni**, joined in matrimony.
rows.why:
Volume 2 of the same film, image 293. **A widower** — so **Magdalena had died** by the end of 1771, twenty-three years after her son's baptism. He has indexed children by Catharina in **1773** and **1776**, which is why the index shows this surname at Fiume in the 1770s under two different mothers.

It also dates the household's shape at the moment Giuseppe starts his own: **in November 1772, when Giuseppe's first son is baptised, his father is a year into a second marriage.**

rows.lab: Fiume, 23 November 1772 and 12 July 1774 — the other household stands at the font
rows.q: Levantibus D.no Francisco Tomassich et **D.na Helena Defranceschi** ··· levantibus **D.no Ignatio Defranceschi** et D.na Theresia Tomasich
rows.why:
Two of Giuseppe's four children carry a Defranceschi godparent, and **both belong to Valentino's house** — *Helena* is Valentino's wife, *Ignatius Francus Mattheus* his son, baptised 29 July 1745. The other two children (1776, 1778) have **no Defranceschi godparent at all**.

**Read carefully, this is weaker than it looks and still worth having.** Helena stands godmother **nine times in twenty frames** across the parish between 1745 and 1747 — she is a *parish* godmother, not a summoned kinswoman, and an earlier reading of her as Giuseppe's grandmother has been withdrawn. **Ignatio is the load-bearing one**: a single appearance of a rare forename. Two houses of one name at one font is **consanguinity of some degree**, not a stated relationship.

rows.lab: The marriage that is not there — twelve years read end to end
rows.why:
**Images 168–191 of film 005497925, both pages, November 1736 to February 1748.** Twenty-four frames. In twelve years of Fiume weddings there is **exactly one Defranceschi marriage**, and it is Valentino's.

**Joannes Baptista and Magdalena are not in it.** Their son was born 24 May 1748, so a Fiume wedding would have fallen inside that window. **They married somewhere else** — as their son Giuseppe would in his turn, and as an incomer does.

**That absence is the most useful thing on this page**, because it sends the question to a specific book. Kobler's correspondent Carlo De Franceschi wrote that a **«Giovanni Batt. De Franceschi venuto dalla Contea di Pisino… intorno al 1740»** was *«senz'altro proveniente dalla mia famiglia»* — **the Gologorica house, which is this archive's own line** — and his pedigree adds that the man **studied at Fiume** and **married a lady of the D'Agnese family**.

**So the whole question reduces to one fact: Magdalena's maiden name.** *D'Agnese confirms Kobler and hangs the Rijeka chain off this archive's own line. Anything else kills it.* And it will be found in **the County of Pazin's registers, which run from 1582 and have never been opened here** — not at Fiume.

people: head of the household; married twice, a widower by December 1771
his first wife; named only in her son's baptism, dead before December 1771. **Her maiden name is the open question of this page.**
born 24 May 1748, baptised 29 May. **Almost certainly the Giuseppe × Francesca of 1772–1778**
his second wife, married 9 December 1771; indexed children 1773 and 1776
note:
**What is documented and what is inferred, kept apart.** *(doc)* the household exists, its head is **Joannes Baptista**, his first wife is **Magdalena**, their son **Josephus Aloysius** is born 24 May 1748, he is a **widower** remarrying in December 1771, and **no marriage of his stands in the Fiume register 1736–1748**. *(inf)* that Josephus Aloysius is the Giuseppe who heads the Rijeka chain — on forename, surname, town, an age of twenty-four, and an unsourced birth year in the family tree that the register has now matched. *(open)* how this household relates to Valentino's, and whether Kobler's Giovanni Battista of the Contea di Pisino is this man.

**He is not one of Valentino's sons.** The only *Joannes Baptista* among Valentino's sixteen children was baptised in **1751** and cannot father a child in 1748.
source: Liber Baptizatorum and the marriage register of St Vitus, Fiume — **film 005497925**. The baptism is **image 150** (`3:1:3QS7-L99F-W4CK`), read 20 September 2026 under magnification. The widower's marriage is **volume 2, image 293**. The marriage sweep covers **images 168–191**, both pages. **None of the 1748 baptism appears in any index**, which is this film's normal state for this family: five of Valentino's sixteen children are unindexed too.
